title: Popup Shop Marketing: 2026 Guide to Planning and Promotion - Shopify Indonesia

facts.fact: According to a 2024 anyroad report cited by Shopify, 51% of brands plan to increase their experiential marketing investment from 2024 through 2026.
facts.quote: planning to increase their experiential marketing investment from 2024 through 2026

facts.fact: According to the anyroad 2024 report cited by Shopify, 43% of brands running in-person events say loyalty is their main goal.
facts.quote: running in-person events say loyalty is their main goal with

facts.fact: According to the same anyroad-cited data, brands that run in-person events measure success with attendance, at 44%, which the page says often does not reflect a loyalty goal.
Shopify's guide defines a popup shop as a temporary physical retail space whose lifespan can range from a few days to a few months.
facts.quote: Its lifespan could be anywhere from a few days to a few months, depending on your goals and budget.

facts.fact: Shopify's guide recommends that a popup shop marketing strategy plan for three stages: pre-launch, during the popup event, and post-event.
facts.quote: a plan for three stages of the popup: pre-launch, during the popup event, and post-event

facts.fact: The Shopify Indonesia guide 'Popup Shop Marketing: 2026 Guide to Planning and Promotion' was published on 20 November 2025 by Michael Keenan and has an 18-minute read time.
